scope.included: All normal playable battle-card identities and released base, Evolution, Hero, or Champion forms available by 2026-09-05.
scope.excluded: Tower troops, temporary/event Super cards, and content first released after 2026-09-05.

slotRules.twoChampionsOrHeroes: allowed using the Hero and Wild slots
slotRules.dualEvolutionHeroCard: Supercell documents one card in the Wild slot switching between its unlocked Evolution and Hero abilities.

simultaneousDuplicateBaseIdentity.finding: The official rule does not explicitly discuss duplicating one base identity into two deck positions. The published flow describes switching one Wild-slot card between forms, so this catalog exposes mutually exclusive form choices on one identity.

modelingNotes.note: ArenaCard requires a number. The catalog carries the legacy public-data value 1, representing Mirror's +1 surcharge; actual deployment cost depends on the previous card.
The API's canonical 6-Elixir value is retained. Spirit Empress also has a 3-Elixir ground deployment; ArenaCard has one numeric elixir field and no separate stance form.

deckLinks.confirmed: Public copyDeck links carry eight ordered base card IDs and an optional Tower Troop ID.
deckLinks.unresolved: No current first-party documentation was found for encoding Evolution/Hero/Champion choices. Public links expose a slots vector, but its current three-slot form semantics are not documented reliably.
deckLinks.implementationGuidance: Keep exporting ordered base IDs. Do not guess form markers; show selected forms beside the link so the player can set the Evolution, Hero, and Wild slots in game.
